name: Klockmort Spannerspan
summary: In Tinkertown, Furen Longbeard's fire-hardened mail findings reach Klockmort Spannerspan. The dwarf smith trusts his gnomish colleague to discover what the new techniques can do.

sections.title: A Colleague in Tinkertown
sections.body: You carry Furen's notes from Stormwind to Ironforge, then on to Tinkertown. There, Klockmort Spannerspan works as a blacksmith and can test the discoveries in his own craft.

sections.title: Gnomish Excitement
sections.body: Gnomish blacksmiths are rare among their dwarven hosts. Klockmort is eager to move beyond traditional metalwork, and the notes excite him with the promise of a breakthrough. He is ready to try the fiery techniques in his own unusual projects.

faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan is a gnomish blacksmith in Tinkertown, within Ironforge. He works with dwarven smiths such as Furen Longbeard on metalworking techniques.

faq.q: Why does Furen Longbeard send you to Klockmort?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard writes down what he discovers while crafting fire-hardened mail. He sends you to Klockmort because the gnome is keen to invent and can experiment with Furen's findings.

faq.q: Where can I find Klockmort Spannerspan?
faq.answer: You can find Klockmort Spannerspan in Tinkertown, the gnome district in eastern Ironforge. He works among its workbenches and machinery.

faq.q: What happens after giving Klockmort the notes?
faq.answer: Furen's breakthrough excites Klockmort, and he begins planning his own metalworking projects. He sends you to gather unusual materials such as iron coral.

faq.q: Is this quest limited to warriors?
faq.answer: Yes. This delivery is part of an armor-crafting chain for Alliance warriors training under veteran weapon and armor masters.

faq.q: Why does Klockmort say he cannot tell day from night?
faq.answer: Ironforge lies beneath the mountains of Dun Morogh. In Tinkertown, stone vaults and glowing lamps keep craftsmen from seeing the sun or sky.

angles.text: As a warrior, you follow a path toward durable battle gear, from dwarven hearths to gnomish invention. You earn the attention of Tinkertown's finest.
As a gnome, you see Klockmort bring dwarven metalworking together with gnomish experimentation in Tinkertown.
As a blacksmith, you carry Furen's notes in an exchange of advanced smithing techniques among Ironforge's master artisans.
